description: Says where a content brief's page went on the site, by the brief's id from mttr_content_next and the page's path. The brief goes live when a later read finds that page, and keeps where the site stood then. Ask for a read with mttr_rescan after.

path.description: The page's path on the site, starting with /, such as /services/sump-pumps.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_content_done
title: Mark a brief done
